report:
# DS-QM063-HOLONOMY-COHERENT-INTENSITY

Two paths with common endpoints acquire the same supplied unit phase under an endpoint gauge repair. New rational Cayley unit phases act on actual Gaussian paths, retaining both real and imaginary relative products and coherent intensity. Source additive integer cochains are separate from a full U(1) connection on every tree.

Supported: Relative Gaussian holonomy and two-path intensity are invariant under the retained common unit phases; the rational unit-phase conditional is universal in Lean.

Remaining: Prove the full graph connection/tree gauge-trivialization and matrix-valued holonomy transports; no SU(2) trace bound or higher-form result is claimed.
